verdict.rationale: The evidence shows HubSpot Marketing Hub has segments that can be used as email recipients or exclusions. It also shows segments can be created from contacts excluded for a specific reason, such as unengaged contacts who haven't opened recent emails, which is a behavioral criterion. Nothing documents a segment builder that combines profile attributes, tags and behavioral events, or segments that update automatically as data changes. missing for 10: documented segment builder with attribute/tag/event filters, evidence that segments stay live and update dynamically, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes

citations.quote: You can set contacts and segments who will receive the email, as well as those that won't receive the email, even if they're included on segment you're sending to.
To create a segment of contacts who won't be sent the email for a specific reason, click **View in segments** in the _Contacts affected_ column.
By default, emails won't be sent to unengaged contacts, as in recipients who haven't opened your last 11 marketing emails.
